content.short: Defi App is a mobile-first platform for swaps, perpetuals and yield across EVM chains.
content.description: Defi App is a modular DeFi interface that bundles swapping, perpetuals and yield into one product. Cross-chain swaps execute automatically, with no bridging step, gas token to hold or slippage to configure, and execution is intent-based. Its yield section aggregates strategies from across DeFi protocols into a single list. Perpetual trading is available alongside spot, including a high-leverage product, and the platform issues the HOME token as a reward.
content.meta: Defi App is a mobile-first platform for swaps, perpetuals and yield across EVM chains and Hyperliquid, with intent-based cross-chain swaps.
